sections.heading: Endowment
sections.text:
Epiphany has an Endowment fund. This fund is designed to last in perpetuity. It is a great way to leave a lasting legacy at Epiphany.

Between 3% and 5% of the fund is withdrawn annually. This money can be used for capital improvements and outreach.

This money has funded improvements at the church, such as HVAC upgrades, funding for local non-profits and for schools.

Our Endowment Fund is merged with endowments from hundreds of other Episcopal Churches. State Street Global Advisors (SSGA) manages the investments and the Episcopal Church Foundation manages the administrative functions.

Contact the church office for more information or to donate.
